resources.string: Keep knees tracking naturally and chest proud.

string-array.name: ex_h1_1_steps
string-array.item: Stand shoulder-width apart and reach arms forward.
Sit hips back as if onto an invisible chair.
Drive through your heels to stand.

resources.string: Keep elbows angled 45 degrees back—never form a T.
Inhale down, exhale as you press.
Letting hips sag toward the floor.

string-array.name: ex_h1_2_steps
string-array.item: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body straight like a plank and lower your chest toward the floor.
Press palms firmly into the floor to rise.

resources.string: Focus on squeezing your glutes rather than arching your back.
Placing feet too far forward and cramping hamstrings.

string-array.name: ex_h1_3_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet near your glutes.
Squeeze glutes to lift hips until shoulders, hips, and knees align.
Hold 2 seconds at the top and lower slowly.

resources.string: Hiking hips too high into a pike.

string-array.name: ex_h1_4_steps
string-array.item: Hold a strong high-plank position.
Drive alternating knees quickly toward your chest.

resources.string: Loads the upper chest and front shoulders.

string-array.name: ex_h2_1_steps
string-array.item: Rest your feet on a sturdy couch or bench.
Place hands on the floor, lower your chest, and press up.

resources.string: Delivers intense triceps and inner-chest activation.
Placing hands directly beneath your face.

string-array.name: ex_h2_2_steps
string-array.item: Form a diamond/triangle with thumbs and index fingers under your chest.
Keep elbows close and press cleanly.

resources.string: Slow eccentrics stimulate deeper muscle growth.
Collapsing onto the floor on the final second.

string-array.name: ex_h2_3_steps
string-array.item: Lower slowly over a full 4-second count.
Lightly touch the floor and push quickly back up.

resources.string: Rotate your shoulder across—don\'t tug your neck.
Cycling too fast with partial range.

string-array.name: ex_h3_1_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with hands lightly by your temples.
Bring right elbow toward left knee while extending right leg, then switch.

resources.string: Stop lowering sooner if your lower back arches off the floor.
Leaving a gap under the lower back.

string-array.name: ex_h3_2_steps
string-array.item: Slide hands under your glutes for support.
Lift straight legs to 90 degrees and lower just above the floor.

resources.string: Tightens the waist and lateral core.

string-array.name: ex_h3_3_steps
string-array.item: Lift hips onto one forearm in a straight side line.
Hold position without letting hips sag.

resources.string: Targets inner thighs and glutes intensely.

string-array.name: ex_h4_1_steps
string-array.item: Step wide with toes turned out 45 degrees.
Squat down with an upright torso and stand back up.

resources.string: Friendlier on knee joints than forward lunges.

string-array.name: ex_h4_2_steps
string-array.item: Step one foot smoothly backward.
Lower rear knee near the floor and drive up through front heel.

string-array.name: ex_h4_3_steps
string-array.item: Extend one leg straight upward.
Drive hips up through the planted heel and squeeze 1 second.

resources.string: Land quietly on the balls of your feet.
Stomping down flat onto the heels.

string-array.name: ex_h5_1_steps
string-array.item: Jump feet out wide while bringing hands overhead.
Jump lightly back to start.

resources.string: Switch to stepping feet if fatigue hurts form.
Letting lower back arch heavily in plank.

string-array.name: ex_h5_2_steps
string-array.item: Place hands on the floor and kick feet into plank.
Return feet forward and jump straight up.

resources.string: Pump arms in rhythm with your legs.

string-array.name: ex_h5_3_steps
string-array.item: Run in place driving knees briskly to hip height.

resources.string: Works nearly the entire body in one fluid movement.
Pausing and pressing purely with arms.

string-array.name: ex_h6_1_steps
string-array.item: Squat with dumbbells racked on your shoulders.
Use upward leg drive to press dumbbells smoothly overhead.

resources.string: Keep neck neutral in line with your spine.

string-array.name: ex_h6_2_steps
string-array.item: Hinge 45 degrees at the hips with a flat back.
Row dumbbells toward your hips and squeeze shoulder blades.

resources.string: Banging elbows hard into the floor.

string-array.name: ex_h6_3_steps
string-array.item: Lie flat on your back with knees bent.
Lower until elbows softly touch the floor, pause, and press up.

resources.string: Move vertebra by vertebra with control.
Sync breath to each arch and round.

string-array.name: ex_h7_1_steps
string-array.item: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders.
Inhale opening your chest gently; exhale rounding your spine skyward.

resources.string: Letting the back knee drop lazily to the floor.

string-array.name: ex_h7_2_steps
string-array.item: Step into a deep lunge with inside hand on the floor.
Rotate the opposite arm skyward to open your chest.

resources.string: Keep heels planted flat on the floor.
Lifting onto the toes with floating heels.

string-array.name: ex_h7_3_steps
string-array.item: Sink into a deep full squat.
Gently press knees outward with your elbows and lift chest.

resources.string: Best bodyweight substitute for overhead shoulder press.

string-array.name: ex_h8_1_steps
string-array.item: Hike hips high into an inverted V shape.
Lower top of head slightly in front of your hands and press up.

resources.string: Keep shoulders pressed down away from ears.
Shifting your body far away from the chair.

string-array.name: ex_h8_2_steps
string-array.item: Grip the edge of a sturdy chair behind you.
Keep your back close, bend elbows to 90 degrees, and press up.

resources.string: Strengthens posterior chain and upright posture.

string-array.name: ex_h8_3_steps
string-array.item: Lie face down with arms and legs extended.
Lift chest and legs gently off the floor for 2 seconds.
